response.original_title: It’s Behind You : Panto set making time lapse film
response.overview: "What took us many weeks to design, build and paint can be seen in just 9 minutes! From pencils to final bows, Cliff Port & Sim Kay filmed the whole making process on a time lapse then cunningly speeded up the film and accompanied it music, what’s not to love!"
response.title: It’s Behind You : Panto set making time lapse film
